svg.text: One React single-page app (Vite · TypeScript · Mantine · Medplum React). The same compiler and renderer serve the drafting preview and the published app — there is no second code path.

hospital, Cognito pool, API URL, modes
the preview never touches real data
Each client has a remote form against the platform — every call carries the Cognito ID token, refreshed before it expires — and a local form for development and the drafting preview.
data primitives, scope-checked before every call
clinical use — registry, runtime, data through the dispatcher
Everything a clinician sees is produced by the renderer from a manifest; the manifest only ever names catalog components and data primitives, and the same catalogs are what the compiler may emit.
